Read Length

## Selecting by length

genomes.path <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm/fcs-gx/kraken2/purge_dups/rag_tag', pattern = '.fasta.gz', full.names = TRUE)
genomes <- list()
for (file in genomes.path) {
  genome <- readDNAStringSet(file)
  unplaced.congtigs <- genome |> names() |> str_subset('RagTag', negate = T)
  writeXStringSet(genome[unplaced.congtigs], here('data', 'unplaced-contigs', str_remove(basename(file), '.gz')))
}

We see there’s one long contig in SC1982 that is not glued (or there’s no cds sequence detected by helixer). ptg000299l_1 is the name of that contig.

Syntenic Plots

Here, we can run orthofinder and genespace to check the synteny of each isolate.

The orthofinder we used is:

orthofinder -f /Users/yixuanyang/project_data/downy/genespace/tmp -t 10 -a 1 -X -o /Users/yixuanyang/project_data/downy/genespace/orthofinder

Reference genomes: Peronospora effusa, Bremia lactucae, Phytophthora sojae

Our isolates: Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1, Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982, Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli

Unplaced contigs

blast.tb <- list.files(here('data', 'unplaced-contigs'), pattern = '.tsv', full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_dfr(function(file) {
    read.table(file) |> mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), '.tsv'))
  })
blast <- data.frame(sample = blast.tb$sample,
                    seqid = blast.tb$V1,
                    e.value = blast.tb$V9,
                    name_or_id2df(blast.tb$V10,mode = 'id',fill_miss_rank = FALSE,add_prefix = FALSE) |> select(Phylum, Species))
blast |> 
  group_by(sample) |> 
  summarise(unplaced.hit=n()) |> 
  gt()
sample unplaced.hit
